sloka: तौ आरोप्य ततः स्कन्धम् राघवो  रजनी चरः  ।विराधो विनदन् घोरम् जगाम अभिमुखो वनम्  ॥३-३-२५॥
transliteration: tau āropya tataḥ skandham rāghavo  rajanī caraḥ  ।virādho vinadan ghoram jagāma abhimukho vanam  ॥3-3-25॥

translations.english: Puffed up with his own great strength, Viradha lifted them and placed them on his shoulders as though they were two children.
